displayNormalization.rule: sphere 1 universal on-screen size for every shape; scene scaled from the canonical tail-on composition; no rescale on toggle; E+A+S keeps this scale and clips truthfully (Q8)

xGrid.convention: station centers at x0M + s * dxM (the rail station grid)

tangentDomain.note: frozen secant rule (spec 4.6); stations outside [i0,i1] carry 0 and make no derivative claim (spec 55.2)

extendedReason: design-intent tail pasted (E+A+S unlock — the Sunship design on any body; absurdity is the point)

grid.stationConvention: uniform inclusive grid per state: x_i = extentM.x0M + i * (extentM.lengthM / (nStations - 1))
grid.thetaConvention: theta = 0 is UP (+y), increasing toward +z; array order is the canonical half-plane enumeration (spec 70)
